Subject: SummitEdge onboarding — enterprise access guardrails (SSO / SCIM / IP / service accounts)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. As promised, I’m sending a concise handoff + proposed mutual action plan (attached) so your infra and security teams have what they need to get us to pilot. High-level asks we discussed:

- SSO: IdP metadata (SAML 2.0) + SP-initiated ACS URL. We support standard NameID formats; our default mapping is email -> primary_login.
- SCIM: Provisioning requires a token scoped for user.create/user.update/user.deactivate and your SCIM base URL. We prefer SCIM v2, JSON.
- IP allowlist: CIDR ranges per region. For pilot keep to a narrow set (3 ranges) for ease of validation; we can expand later.
- Service accounts: We will need one service account for event ingestion + one ephemeral account for admin automation. See attached service-account-template.txt for recommended least-priv roles.
- Org policies: any org-level SSO policies (MFA required, username normalization) that could affect provisioning or login flows.

Next steps (proposed timeline):
1) You share IdP metadata + SCIM test token by EOD Wed (3/7).
2) Redwood engineers validate in staging and share test users by Thu (3/8).
3) Dry-run cutover over the weekend (3/10) with rollback window.

Please confirm the token scope and whether you want us to start with SP-initiated only or both SP/IdP. I attached the draft MAP (mutual_action_plan) and a short checklist to speed the security review.

Best,
Priyom
Technical Program Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: summitedge-map-v1.pdf (MAP), sso-scim-ip-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), service-account-template.txt
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@summitedge.com>

Cc: Tom Lang <tom.lang@summitedge.com>, Aaron Weiss <aaron.weiss@summitedge.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SummitEdge onboarding — enterprise access guardrails (SSO / SCIM / IP / service accounts)

Thanks Priyom — useful checklist. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- SCIM token: we can issue a scoped token limited to /Users and /Groups but our token rotation policy will require ~7 day expiry; will that break your staging runs?
- IP ranges: we have two static egress ranges for our staging environment (34.198.0.0/16, 18.205.0.0/16). Production will add additional ranges once we flip.
- Service account roles: we like the least-priv template but our security lead wants an additional audit-only account that can only read audit logs; is that supported?

Also looping Aaron (security) — Aaron, can you review the MAP and confirm the SCIM token cadence is acceptable?

Elena
Senior Product Ops, SummitEdge

Elena / Aaron —

Thanks for the quick reply. Short answers:

- SCIM token rotation: staging runs will tolerate short-lived tokens — our validation harness can re-auth on token refresh if you provide a rotation webhook or a service principal that can mint tokens. If neither is available, we can run a manual refresh cadence during the pilot.
- IP ranges: those two staging CIDRs work. Please attach the exact CIDR blocks and the contact for network change requests so our infra team can coordinate the allowlist change.
- Audit-only account: yes — we support read-only roles for audit consumption; add that to the template and we’ll map it to a read-only role in our RBAC layer.

Action items I’ll take on:
- Ben will provision a staging SP and share the ACS URL and certificate thumbprint (by Wed 3/7).
- I’ll coordinate a 30-min test window Thurs 3/8 10:00–10:30 PT for SCIM provisioning verification.

Elena / Aaron — can you confirm the person who will deliver the SCIM test token (name + email) and the network contact for IP allowlist requests?

Thanks,
Priyom
